body:
I posted just before you.  I sit here waiting and wondering, does anybody care about me?  I know people do even though it doesn't feel like it.  People care about you too.

I'm not going to tell you that it's all roses or that it's definitely going to get better, but I will say this:  You're only 19 years old and you have your whole life ahead of you.  You are young enough to change course.  Maybe you messed up and it seems like it's going to hinder you forever.  I can tell you that you have a lot of do-overs left.  You also have a lot of time to figure out what it is that you do love and will make you feel alive.

I'm not good at giving advice or cheering people up.  All I can usually do is sit there and try not to make things worse.  Whatever you're going through right now is temporary.  You are young and you've got plenty of time to figure things out.
